evidence: Initializer 140d580d0 loads the directly verified NUL-terminated literal ReporterTelemetry at 14172006c, stores it on descriptor 1458afdd0 at 140d5810c, calls the Thing base-descriptor helper at 140d58141 and tail-jumps to field registrar 140d6c700 at 140d5814c.

All 14 registered labels and field offsets match visitor 1404de8c0. The distinctive fields are TelemetryKey1..6 at +0xe0, +0xe8, +0xf0, +0xf8, +0x100 and +0x108, and TimeSinceSend at +0x110. Halfsize is +0xd8; Name remains +0xc8.

Complete 269-instruction / 1,249-byte assembly preserves the object in R14, constructs the six key addresses for the GadgetName property visitor and reads TimeSinceSend from object +0x110 at 1404ded8c. Register assignments, rather than suppressed cached prototype arguments, establish the matches.

The known Thing type property dispatcher calls this visitor at 14048cbe4; its existing cached switch case 0x51 corroborates the independent field match. The adjacent shorter visitor 1404de660 lacks the telemetry extension fields.
limitations: The names describe property/metadata roles, not original recovered symbols.

The eight extension fields (Halfsize, six telemetry keys and TimeSinceSend) are gated by visitor state +0x1c >= 0x1869f (99,999), with additional property-filter conditions. Whether this path is used by normal game data is unestablished.
This evidence does not establish network transmission, recipients, telemetry payloads or the runtime reporting algorithm.
No signature, datatype, calling convention, parameter or variable changes are proposed.
